name: io.github.derekslinz/meta-data-mcp
description: Query 83 open data APIs — government, science, finance, environment, and more.

io.github.derekslinz.anonymous_access: All tools are available without credentials. Some providers require a free API key set as an environment variable on the server side — the connecting client never handles keys.
io.github.derekslinz.pitch: One MCP server, 83 open data sources. Ask about GDP, earthquakes, court records, air quality, drug approvals, satellite imagery, or biodiversity — meta-data-mcp routes the request to the right API and returns structured data. Providers activate lazily so the default tool surface stays small; use opendata_providers_find to discover and opendata_providers_activate to unlock domain-specific tools on demand.
example_calls: opendata_providers_find({ query: "climate" })  ->  ranked list of climate/weather providers
opendata_providers_activate({ provider_id: "global-world-bank" })  ->  activates World Bank tools
opendata_domains_list()  ->  full taxonomy of covered domains
mcp_registry_search({ q: "open data" })  ->  discover other open-data MCP servers

tools.name: opendata_providers_find
tools.description: Semantic search across 83 providers — ranked matches with health scores and domain tags.

tools.name: opendata_providers_activate
tools.description: Lazily activate a provider to expose its domain-specific tools without restarting the server.

tools.name: opendata_providers_deactivate
tools.description: Deactivate a provider and remove its tools from the active surface.

tools.name: opendata_providers_list
tools.description: List all available providers with metadata and health scores.

tools.name: opendata_providers_list_active
tools.description: List currently activated providers and their exposed tools.

tools.name: opendata_domains_list
tools.description: List all data domains covered (government, science, finance, environment, health, law, and more).

tools.name: opendata_regions_list
tools.description: List geographic regions with available providers.

tools.name: opendata_providers_describe
tools.description: Full metadata for a provider: tools, endpoints, auth requirements, health score.

tools.name: opendata_health_snapshot
tools.description: Real-time health scores for all providers — uptime, latency, error rates.

tools.name: opendata_explain_choice
tools.description: Explain why a specific provider was ranked or selected for a query.

tools.name: opendata_plugins_draft
tools.description: Generate a provider spec scaffold for a new open data API.

tools.name: opendata_plugins_create
tools.description: Create and register a new provider plugin from a spec.

tools.name: mcp_registry_search
tools.description: Search the official MCP server registry — meta-data-mcp can discover other MCP servers.

tools.name: mcp_registry_list
tools.description: List all servers in the MCP registry, with pagination.
